newsitem.title: USA: American Greetings to buy Foster Grant.
newsitem.headline: American Greetings to buy Foster Grant.

text.p: American Greetings Corp said Monday it agreed to buy the Foster Grant Group, one of the nation's largest distributors of moderately-priced sunglasses, from BEC Group Inc.
Terms of the deal, which is expected to close on September 30, were not disclosed.
Foster Grant, which has annual net sales of about $90 million, will continue to be run from its Dallas headquarters.
The deal will leave BEC effectively debt free and well-positioned to pursue its growth strategy in its remaining businesses, BEC's chief executive Martin Franklin said.
The sale is subject to the approval of the boards of both companies, the receipt of any necessary governmental approvals and the completion of due diligence, American Greetings said.
